title: Claude usage
description: Keeps working alone to the daily ration of your Claude subscription: a session starts only while the week's usage is at least n points behind the share of the week gone (a day ≈ 14.3; early in the week half the share gone, so a new week starts at once; in its last 2 hours what is left goes when it holds a session; once it waited, it goes again only with 2 more in hand, then for several sessions in a row): strom config set run.gate "claude-usage 10" (without a number: 0). A cap: "claude-usage 10 --cap 95" — at 95 % of the week no session starts, in any run, and no "start anyway" goes past it.
